items.name: At least one moving transmission
items.evidence: A 1:1 spur-sector pair is in CAD. The instructor must confirm that a 1:1 pair counts; the fallback is a pinion stage of 2:1 or more.

items.name: At least one DC motor
items.evidence: The servo has a brushed DC motor inside it, which needs the instructor's confirmation. Fallback: a gearmotor with an 8:1 stage that closes in 0.58 s.

items.name: At least one analog input
items.evidence: Force sensor on finger B into an analog pin, sampled at 1 kHz. The bench read trace is still to be logged.

items.name: At least one digital button
items.evidence: Start button (a press advances, a 0.8 s hold stops) and the jaw-open limit, both debounced and logged.

items.name: Microcontroller
items.evidence: ESP32 DevKitC firmware compile has not run; arduino-cli is needed to check it.

items.name: State machine and event-driven code
items.evidence: 12 states and a 69-row transition table with no blocking waits. The host test takes every row and passes 2124 checks.

items.name: PWM actuator, not the arm's serial bus
items.evidence: DSServo DS3230 MG at 50 Hz, 500 to 2500 µs.

items.name: At most $50 per actuator
items.evidence: DSServo DS3230 MG, $27.00.

items.name: Compact
items.evidence: Keep-outs are clean in CAD. Roll gaps: 4.17 mm in the -2 to -1 mm band; 4.07 mm in the -1 to 0 mm band; 0.95 mm in the 0 to 1 mm band; 1.27 mm in the 1 to 2 mm band; 0.59 mm in the 2 to 5.3 mm band. Outside the stock envelope in 1 band.

items.name: Mass-moment within 43,720 g mm
items.evidence: 152.9 g with cloth, centred 37.6 mm past the horn: 52,995 g mm, 121 % of budget.

items.name: Public, cited sources only
items.evidence: Every analysis document lists its sources and marks assumed numbers.

items.name: Tip stiffness 0.88 to 1.63 N/mm
items.evidence: 1.101 N/mm in plane and 0.922 across layers. Bench test pending.

items.name: Gear strength at hold, cap and stall
items.evidence: Printed PA6-CF pair: root safety factor 5.11, 2.83 and 1.61; shock 1.59.

items.name: Hold at least 5 N per pad
items.evidence: The DSServo DS3230 MG holds 1.151 N m against 0.792 needed. Rev A's DS3218MG fails if tension exceeds 2.07 N or friction drops below 0.386.

items.name: Pad force at most 10 N
items.evidence: The firmware caps the squeeze at 5.14° past touch, which keeps any finger in the stiffness window at or under 10 N by position, behind a 7.5 N soft limit and an 8 N trip. The finger still folds at 8.88 N.

items.name: Hold at most 40 % of stall
items.evidence: Needs 20.2 kg cm of stall; the DSServo DS3230 MG gives 29.33 at 6.5 V, a vendor listing figure; not yet measured on the delivered part.

items.name: Moment arm at most 65 mm
items.evidence: 65.0 mm in CAD.

items.name: Jaw range −11° to +20°
items.evidence: The jaw sweep in CAD is clash-free at −11.0, −7.4, 0.0, 10.0, 20.0° against every static part.

items.name: Full close within 0.5 s
items.evidence: The firmware simulation touches at 0.58 to 0.59 s and reaches 4.5 N at 0.67 to 0.72 s. The torque model says 0.278 s. Needs a ruling and a timed video.

items.name: Back off a stall within 200 ms
items.evidence: Host test: the back-off begins 140 ms after over-current starts and its command completes at 200 ms. The current threshold and the blocked-finger test are pending.

items.name: Calibration stores the contact angle
items.evidence: Calibration zeroes the sensor, closes at 20 °/s to 0.5 N and stores the contact angle. The simulation lands within 0.2° of the true angle.

items.name: Wrist interface
items.evidence: A separate wrist-mount plate on the horn. The pilot fit reaches a capability of only 1.25, so a coupon is needed.

items.name: Camera provision
items.evidence: A wrist camera pad is modelled. The primary camera is fixed off the arm.

items.name: Work cell
items.evidence: The layout sketch has not been checked against the shoulder reach rule.

items.name: Life of at least 100,000 grips
items.evidence: Gears pass at 6.2e7 grips. The finger's pessimistic hot spot is 4.3e3 grips, rising to 3.1e6 with the printed knock-down.

items.name: Case at most 60 °C after 30 min
items.evidence: The thermal model fails 9 of 12 cases, for example 115 °C at 40 °C ambient. Measure it.

items.name: 6 V rail delivers 3 A
items.evidence: The rail is specified at 6.5 V and 3 A. One motor fit implies a 3.77 A stall.
